title: B
description:
Fox Ciel has some flowers: r red flowers, g green flowers and b blue flowers. She wants to use these flowers to make several bouquets. There are 4 types of bouquets:

  To make a "red bouquet", it needs 3 red flowers.  To make a "green bouquet", it needs 3 green flowers.  To make a "blue bouquet", it needs 3 blue flowers.  To make a "mixing bouquet", it needs 1 red, 1 green and 1 blue flower. 

Help Fox Ciel to find the maximal number of bouquets she can make.


-----Input-----

The first line contains three integers r, g and b (0 ≤ r, g, b ≤ 10^9) — the number of red, green and blue flowers.


-----Output-----

Print the maximal number of bouquets Fox Ciel can make.


-----Examples-----
Input
3 6 9

Output
6

Input
4 4 4

Output
4

Input
0 0 0

Output
0



-----Note-----

In test case 1, we can make 1 red bouquet, 2 green bouquets and 3 blue bouquets.

In test case 2, we can make 1 red, 1 green, 1 blue and 1 mixing bouquet.
output:
6

4

0

In test case 1, we can make 1 red bouquet, 2 green bouquets and 3 blue bouquets.

In test case 2, we can make 1 red, 1 green, 1 blue and 1 mixing bouquet.
standard_solution_code:
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
a.sort()
if a[0] == 0:
	print(a[1] // 3 + a[2] // 3)
	exit()
b = a.copy()
c = a.copy()
ans = min(a)
a[1] -= ans
a[2] -= ans
ans += a[1] // 3
ans += a[2] // 3
ans1 = min(b) - 1
b[1] -= ans1
b[2] -= ans1
ans1 += b[1] // 3
ans1 += b[2] // 3
ans2 = min(c) - 2
c[1] -= ans2
c[2] -= ans2
ans2 += c[1] // 3
ans2 += c[2] // 3
print(max(ans2, ans1, ans))
